references.text: Moses repeats the command to lay God's words on the heart, with almost identical wording as in 6:6
Proverbs encourages binding a parent's commands on the heart, reflecting the message of having God's word in the heart
Encouragement to bind words of wisdom on the fingers and write them on the tablet of the heart
The prophecy of the new covenant where God will put his law within them and write it on their hearts
Ezekiel prophesies that God will give the people a new heart with his Spirit, so that they keep his commands
Paul speaks of the church as a letter written on tablets of human hearts, not on stone tablets
Hebrews quotes Jeremiah's prophecy that God will put his laws in their minds and write them on their hearts
Repeats the promise of the new covenant where God's laws are placed on the hearts
